name: Maquina Expendedora Con Dolares y Monedas de 25 Centavos
untr_name: Vending Machine With Dollars and Quarters
description: Supongamos que tenemos una maquina expendedora que da cambio. Un cliente selecciona un articulo para comprar e inserta un billete en la maquina expendedora. La maquina entrega el articulo comprado y da cambio. Supondremos que todos los precios de los articulos son multiplos de 25 centavos, y la maquina da todo el cambio en dolares y monedas de 25 centavos. Construya un programa que calcule cuantos dolares y cuantas monedas de 25 centavos devolver al cliente.
untr_description: Suppose we have a vending machine that gives change. A customer selects an item for purchase and inserts a bill into the vending machine. The vending machine dispenses the purchased item and gives change. We will assume that all item prices are multiples of 25 cents, and the machine gives all change in dollar and quarters. Construct a program that computes how many dollars and quarters to return to the customer.

distractors.description: Podrias pensar que dividir por PENNIES_PER_DOLLAR actualizara correctamente el cambio restante, pero esta es una confucion comun entre las operaciones de division y modulo. La division te dara el numero de dolares completos, no el cambio restante despues de contabilizar los dolares. Usar esta linea resultaria en calculos incorrectos para el cambio restante, ya que estableceria changeDue al numero de dolares en lugar de los centavos sobrantes. Esto llevaria a resultados incorrectos al calcular las monedas de 25 centavos, porque el cambio restante no se habria reducido apropiadamente.
distractors.untr_description: You might think that dividing by PENNIES_PER_DOLLAR will correctly update the change due, but this is a common confusion between division and modulus operations. Division will give you the number of whole dollars, not the remaining change after dollars are accounted for. Using this line would result in incorrect calculations for the remaining change, as it would set changeDue to the number of dollars instead of the leftover pennies. This would lead to incorrect results when calculating quarters, as the remaining change would not be properly reduced.

distractors.description: Podrias creer que restar PENNIES_PER_DOLLAR de changeDue actualizara correctamente el cambio restante, pero este enfoque solo resta una cantidad fija, no el valor total de todos los dolares ya contabilizados. Esto resultaria en un cambio restante incorrecto, ya que no considera multiplos de dolares. El programa calcularia incorrectamente el numero de monedas de 25 centavos porque changeDue no reflejaria la cantidad real restante despues de quitar todos los dolares.
distractors.untr_description: You might believe that subtracting PENNIES_PER_DOLLAR from changeDue will correctly update the remaining change, but this approach only subtracts a fixed amount, not the total value of dollars already accounted for. This would result in an incorrect remaining change, as it doesn't account for multiple dollars. The program would incorrectly calculate the number of quarters because the changeDue would not reflect the actual leftover amount after all dollars are removed.
